rules.infinite_in_degree: X_1(28) has only finitely many points of degree 5
rules.sporadic: finitely many points of each degree <= 5 on X_1(28)
rules.isolated: finitely many points of degree 5 on X_1(28), so the point lies in no positive-dimensional family

points.reference: M. van Hoeij, Low degree places on the modular curve X1(N), arXiv:1202.4355; data file LowDegreePlaces (Aug 2013), line 53

rules.infinite_in_degree: X_1(28) has infinitely many points of degree 9
rules.sporadic: not sporadic: X_1(28) has infinitely many points of degree 6
rules.isolated: dim L(x) = 1 (P^1-isolated) and rank J_1 over Q is 0 (AV-isolated)

points.reference: Noted in E. González-Jiménez, F. Najman, An algorithm for determining torsion growth of elliptic curves, Exp. Math. 32 (2023), 70-81, arXiv:1904.07071; identified as isolated by A. Bourdon, D. R. Gill, J. Rouse, L. D. Watson, Odd degree isolated points on X_1(N) with rational j-invariant, arXiv:2006.14966 (2020), Theorem 2 and Section 4.7.
